title: Broadcom stock falls 6% as this firm flags AI financing risks
description: Broadcom shares AVGO fell more than 6% on Friday after Rothschild & Co Redburn downgraded the semiconductor company, citing concerns about its growing exposure to artificial intelligence financing arrangements. The investment firm lowered its rating on Broadcom to Neutral from Buy and cut its price target by 33%, from $595 to $398. The downgrade comes after Broadcom shares rallied over the previous five trading sessions as investors looked beyond Nvidia's leadership turmoil and considered the potential benefits for rival chipmakers. However, Rothschild & Co Redburn believes the optimism surrounding Broadcom's potential market share gains may be premature, particularly as questions remain about its exposure to AI infrastructure financing.
